          Question Bank

          All questions your students will practise. Switch to the grid to pick questions by eye, then build a worksheet from them.

          🔍 Check answer keys ChatGPT and Gemini each solve the question from scratch, at the same time. The report compares their two answers with your stated answer, your working and your marking guide, and recommends what to do.

          📋 Vetting

          Questions the AI has read but nobody has checked yet. Students never see these — approve one into the bank when it looks right. The 📐 badges are the syllabus objectives the AI filed it under; ✎ Edit to change them.

          🗑️ Bin

          Questions you deleted, from the question bank or from vetting. ♻️ Restore one within 7 days and it goes back exactly where it came from, answer key and all. After that it is deleted forever — the sweep runs each time you open the app.

          Student Results

          Recent logins, activity and every question each student has attempted — tap a student to open their full question log with times.

          🧠 AI Engine

          Choose which AI powers every mode in this app — the AI answer & explanation, Build from screenshot / PDF, Rapid add, marking, and the ✨ art generator in 🌌 Aetherfall. Your choice is saved on this device only and stays until you change it. If ChatGPT ever fails, the app falls back to Gemini automatically, so nobody is ever left without an AI.

          🔗 One key covers all four subjects. Maths, Science, English and Chinese share this browser's storage, so a key saved here is saved for all of them — and 🔍 Check answer keys can put ChatGPT and Gemini side by side in whichever app you are in.

          Used only by the ✨ AI art generator on 🌌 Aetherfall → Card Art — the chat model above cannot draw. If ChatGPT image generation fails, the app falls back to the Gemini image model.

          Moonshot renames its flagship with every release, so this is a box, not a fixed list: 🔄 Load models asks your own Kimi account which ids it will answer to. If Kimi starts refusing every call, an out-of-date id here is the first thing to check.

          You should not normally need this. Kimi's real key lives on the server, as a Firebase secret behind the askKimi Cloud Function in this repo's functions/ — which is what lets a student's phone use it with nothing set up on it. A key typed here is only a fallback for this browser, and it is what 🔄 Load models reads the list with.

          The key is saved only in this browser (localStorage) on this device — never uploaded, synced or committed anywhere. Anyone with this device's developer tools could read it, so paste it only on machines you control. Devices without a key simply keep using Gemini.

          Dictation has its own model and is not switched by the choice above: a speech model transcribes better than a chat model, and the chat model stands behind it so a mic never simply stops working.

          ✂️ Crop & reposition

          Drag the box to move it; drag a handle to resize. Then tap Apply crop.

          ✏️ Touch up & label

          100%
          Selection:
          ✨ Regenerate: changes the whole picture
          Transforming the whole picture:  

          Erase / Paint: drag over the image — click then Shift-click joins the two points with a straight line (Photoshop style), and Shift-drag locks the stroke to horizontal / vertical. Fill: click inside a shape to flood it with colour. Clone: click to set the source, then drag to stamp that area elsewhere (Alt+click re-sets the source) — once the source is set, the ring under your pointer shows the exact patch that will be stamped, so you can line it up before you press. History: brush the original picture back by hand. Select / Lasso / Wand: mark out an area, then fill it, move it, use AI content-aware fill, or 🗑️ Delete it (Esc deselects).
          🗑️ Cutting a picture out: pick 🪄 Wand, click the background, then press 🗑️ Delete (or the Delete key). Those pixels are taken away rather than painted over, so what is left is see-through — shown as a checkerboard, which is nothing, not a grey pattern. Alt+click the wand to take that colour across the whole picture at once, widen Match ± if a fringe is left behind, and Apply saves a PNG with a transparent background — which is what makes a card, avatar, artifact or pack frame sit on the game screens with no white box round it. Move: drag inside a selection to cut it out and drop it anywhere (Alt to copy), or drag a text label to reposition it. Resize: drag the handles round the box to make the selected object bigger or smaller — corners resize both ways, edges one way, and the corner opposite the one you drag stays exactly where it is. Drag inside the box to move it, hold Shift to swap between keeping the shape and stretching it freely, or type a width / height percentage in the panel. Rotate / Skew: turn or slant the selected object — or, with nothing selected, the whole picture, which is how you straighten a page that went into the scanner crooked. Drag on the image (Shift snaps to 15°) or use the sliders, and 📐 Straighten lets you trace a line along a crooked edge to level it in one go. Enter applies the turn, Esc cancels it. Line: drag from start to end. Text: click, type, then Enter.
          📋 Paste a picture: press Ctrl+V (⌘V) — or the 📋 button — to drop whatever picture is on the clipboard straight onto this one. It lands scaled to fit inside the picture, with the resize handles already on it: drag a corner to size it, drag the middle to move it, turn or slant it if you want, then ✓ Apply to burn it in (Esc takes it away again).
          Scroll over the image to zoom (down to single pixels); hold Space (or the middle mouse button) and drag to pan; scroll over either slider to change it. Set the brush to 1 px for pixel-perfect edits.
          Brush size: Erase, Paint, Clone, History and Line draw a ring around your pointer at the exact size of the mark they will make, at whatever zoom you are on — so you can see the brush before you use it. Change the size with the slider, the wheel over it, or [ and ], and the size is shown on the picture as you change it. With Clone the ring is filled with the pixels it is about to stamp — move the pointer and the preview moves with it, so a patch is aimed by looking at it rather than by counting across from the source pin.
          ✨ Regenerate: type what you want in the purple bar and the AI redraws it. Select an area first and only that area can change; with nothing selected the whole picture is redrawn. It is one step either way, so ↶ Undo puts the picture straight back if the AI missed.
          Keys: E erase · B paint · G fill · S clone · Y history · M select · L lasso · W wand · V move · R rotate · K skew · F resize · U line · T text · [ ] brush size · Delete cut the selection out · Ctrl+Z undo · + − zoom · 0 fit · Esc deselect / cancel the transform · Enter apply
